target.title: fix(agents): sanitize OpenAI composite tool ids on cross-provider replay
target.body:
## Summary

- Fix cross-provider failover replay bricking Anthropic sessions when history contains OpenAI Responses composite tool ids (\call_*|fc_*\).
- \preserveReplaySafeThinkingToolCallIds\ was skipping sanitization for entire signed-thinking assistant turns, letting pipe characters reach Anthropic wire format validation.

Fixes #95623

## Root cause

After failover to OpenAI Responses, tool turns can persist \call_XXX|fc_YYY\ ids. On return to Anthropic, replay-safe thinking preservation returned those messages unchanged even though strict id sanitization was enabled.

## Test plan

- [x] \
ode scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tool-call-id.test.ts\
- [x] \
ode scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.tool-call-normalization.test.ts\
